mapper.sql: WITH user_subjects AS (SELECT 'USER' AS sub_type, #{userId} AS sub_id UNION ALL SELECT 'DEPT' AS sub_type, dc.ancestor_id AS sub_id FROM user_dept ud JOIN dept_closure dc ON ud.dept_id = dc.descendant_id JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = ud.dept_id AND d.status = 1 JOIN sys_dept da ON da.id = dc.ancestor_id AND da.status = 1 WHERE ud.user_id = #{userId} AND ud.status IN (1, 2) UNION ALL SELECT 'POST' AS sub_type, up.post_id AS sub_id FROM user_post up INNER JOIN sys_post sp ON sp.id = up.post_id AND sp.status = 1 WHERE up.user_id = #{userId} AND up.status IN (1, 2) -- 未来扩展：在此处 UNION ALL 增加 PROJECT 或其他主体即可 -- UNION ALL SELECT 'PROJECT', project_id FROM user_project ... )
